I posted the answer in #strategic-pod: Vantorre Group is at 280 seats.

Gideon first wrote 300 in his Jul 1 update, then corrected it a few minutes later. The 300 counted sandbox logins from the May rollout. He gave 280 as the active production count as of Jul 1, and Ruth acknowledged the correction. Use 280 for the roster sheet.
